messages:
emma.docs: Heads up — PR #7896 adds an export of the invoke/structured-output snippets but I spotted several broken links and some SDK examples that are stale w.r.t. function/tool calling changes. Plan: export canonical snippet pack, run a link-scrub, and sync SDK examples + a short migration note. Who can own which pieces?
lee.sre: I can run the link-scrub and produce a short report of 404s/redirects. need the list of pages to check (or I can run across the whole docs site).
omar.eng: We should bundle the canonical examples into a single artifact (eg /assets/snippets/invoke-snippets-v1.tgz). Also note: there are a couple examples still using `function_call` fields instead of the new `tool_call` wrapper — will include a migration blurb in the export.
nina.sdk: I'll update JS/Python snippets once the canonical pack is available. prefer examples use `await client.invoke(...)` for JS and `client.invoke(...)` for Python to match SDK ergonomics. ping me after export.
ada: sorry typo 
ada: (meant ada.research) Watch out for structured-output examples that relied on freeform JSON — we should add explicit JSON Schema examples and a small parse snippet showing robust parsing + fallback. I'll draft the sample parse code.
sam.product: One more ask from PMs — the quickstart CTA on the invoke page points to the old shallow quickstart. Can we update that to the new migration quickstart? PR reference: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/7896 (current).
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: docs-deploy queued for staging. linkcheck job scheduled as `docs/linkcheck` — status will post here when done.
emma.docs: Quick checklist I'm adding to the follow-up PR: 1) export canonical snippets + artifact 2) run link-scrub and fix 404s 3) update SDK snippets (JS/Py) 4) add migration note (function_call -> tool_call & response envelope) 5) provide structured-output parse examples (schema + resilient parser) 6) update top-level CTAs and quickstart links.
omar.eng: I'll produce the artifact and upload to /assets/snippets/invoke-snippets-v1.tgz and post a sha256. ETA ~3h.
nina.sdk: :thumbsup: I'll carve out 2h after lunch to update examples and make smaller tests to ensure they run with our latest SDK. keeping examples under ~40 lines.
lee.sre: Link-scrub run complete — found 7 broken links and 3 internal redirects. Short log excerpt:```
LINKCHECK REPORT
- /docs/invoke/old-quickstart -> 404
- /docs/sdk/js/old-invoke-sample -> redirect to /docs/sdk/js/invoke (mismatch)
- https://external.example.com/tooling-guide -> 404
- /assets/snippets/missing-example.json -> 404
- /docs/invoke/compact-format -> 200
- /docs/invoke/structured-output -> 200
```
I'll open a tiny PR to fix the obvious 404s and add redirects for 2 internal pages.
ada: (ada.research) One more flag: I found a snippet using `oneOf` without a discriminator which makes our parsing examples ambiguous. Recommend converting to a discriminated union with a `type` field and updating the parsing snippet to check `type` first. I'll attach a suggested diff in the PR.
sam.product: UX note: please add a small 'migration quickstart' card at the top of the invoke page linking to the migration checklist — product will approve copy.
emma.docs: Thanks! I'll open PR 7902 with the checklist + initial fixes and tag @nina.sdk and @lee.sre for review. ETA: PR later today. Assigning follow-ups: nina.sdk (SDK snippets), lee.sre (link fixes), omar.eng (artifact upload), ada.research (schema diffs). tagging @here for visibility :mega:
